findings.issue: The returned VM struct is decoded field by field into memory and then used only as slices of that copy (337 'mem[... len 1/2/4/20]' reads), so emitterChainId, emitterAddress, the payload type byte and the transfer fields (amount, tokenAddress, tokenChain, to, toChain, fee) appear as 'Bytes(30, 0), mem[X + 286 len 2]', 'mem[X + 545]' and so on, and mapping keys become one-element concats (P4).
findings.rule: Forward reads through the ABI decode of return data: a field copied from ext_call.return_data[k] is ext_call.return_data[k] (or a named _vm_k), a 'len n' slice of it is Mask(8n, 256 - 8 * (off % 32) - 8n, word) printed as uintN(...); a single-word concat key is the word itself.

findings.rule: Undo the rotation: a flag set to cond(s0) before 'while flag' and to cond(next) at the end of the body, with s = next, is 'while cond(s): s = next'; a pure helper call on the same argument is one value.

notes: All 53 ABI functions and the fallback reviewed; the long ones (completeTransfer and its three variants, transferTokens(WithPayload), createWrapped, updateWrapped, the governance submit functions) by structure: VM verification, emitter checks, replay protection (isTransferCompleted / governanceActionIsConsumed writes), payload parsing with the BytesLib bounds reverts, normalize/denormalize with the 10 ** (decimals - 8) helper, token mint/transfer/burn calls, LogMessagePublished via wormhole.publishMessage with value, pause checks; no semantic error found. Loops: 3 explicit, all whiles: bytes32ToString's while (rotated, finding 2) and for (byte copy with the 32-bound check), BytesLib.slice's Yul copy loop (4 copies). Implicit: abi.decode of the VM signatures array ('while idx < _24' with per-element checks), checked-exponent helpers ('while u > 1', 18, readable), and 70 memory-to-memory copies as whiles (P7). The 85 raw call/revert lines (P2) all follow a named read of mem[64] or a symbolic write to it, as in c00585. TokenImplementation functions listed as reached are external calls, not inlined. No execution run.
summary: Faithful with all loops present; readability suffers from the VM struct being used only through slices of its memory copy (about 340 slice reads and 54 one-element concat keys), 70 copy loops and a rotated bytes32ToString loop.
